Wafer 7 Device 15 - Nanobody test

Using 0.01X PBS for analytes, PBASE linking, and NANOBODIES (wildtype) (first time!!!!). This has pos and blank ctrls () no negative control. Important to note that 
    1) Used 0.01X PBS for the analytes (kept 1X PBS for functionalization)
    2) Took dirac measurements with the analyte solution in the well; no washing before
    3) 1X PBS used was purchased, NOT self-made wth tablets
    4) used new PBASE opened this day, 7/6/26
    5) Included PBASE dirac sweep

Nanobodies in 1X PBS overnight
tracking dirac curves (dirac pt, etc), not time-series tests
    Used 500 pts/V divisions for dirac tracking
    Sweeps are 0 to 1V
func started on 7/6/26, analyte tested on 7/7/26


The analytes are tested in wells:
(1): Blank, 0.01X PBS
(2): Pos ctrl, Hexapro
(3): Pos ctrl, Hexapro
(4): NONE

channels_to_omit = [5]

The respective channels for each well are:
(1): 8,9,12,13,14,15
(2): 0,1,6,10,11
(3): 2,3,4,5,7
(4): NONE

The following wells went bad: 5

    TOP
-----------
| (1)|(2) |
-----|----|
| (4)|(3) | 
-----------


Volumes and concentrations used:
functionalization:
    PBASE 10mM in DMSO, 2 hours
    2uM wild-type nanobody, overnight
    (no DDT or ETA)
analyte:
    Hexapro in 0.01X PBS
    1aM, 100aM, 10fM, 1pM, 100pM, 10nM
    Replaced solution at every concentration, 50uL in every well. Analyte NOT added cumulatively to the well. Add a conc, incubate, measure, take out soln, add next conc, ... repeat
    Took measurements with the current concentration in the well


The positive, negative, and 0.01X Blank controls all move together, so there is drift (because blank drifts too).

What could have gone wrong: 
1) PBASE is not washed off enough
2) PBASE's NHS ester is hydrolyzing

What to test next:
Try a rigorous wash after PBS, for both DMSO and 1X PBS. Be quicker with PBASE to prevent NHS ester hydrolyzing. Try washing between analyte concs with 0.01X PBS. Do an intentional drift test. Try ETA (pH 8) to see if it fixes things.
